title: Aircover Pipeline — agent-outputs/agent_<meeting_id>.json (v1.0)
description: Coaching agent output for a single meeting, written one file per meeting under <output-dir>/agent-outputs/.

meeting_id.description: Aircover meeting identifier — matches a row in meetings.json.

deal_id.description: Mirrored from meetings.json. May be empty.

date.description: Mirrored from meetings.json. May be empty for legacy meetings.

template_id.description: Coaching template id this output was generated against.

properties.description: Keyed by property id (a stable identifier defined in the template). Each value is the agent's structured result for that property.

title.description: Human-readable label for the property (e.g., 'Pain Points').

result.description: The agent's textual response for this property. 'N/A' if the agent had no response.

score.description: Numeric score the agent assigned. Returned as a string in some legacy responses; treat as numeric when possible.

max_score.description: Maximum possible score for this property as defined in the template. Use to compute percentages.
